Here's the summary of what was done and the recommendations:

## Build Performance Analysis & Optimizations

**Baseline**: ~10s clean build (with analyzers disabled manually); build **broken** by default due to style analyzers + `TreatWarningsAsErrors`.

**Optimized**: ~5.5s local dev build, all tests passing.

### Changes Made

| Optimization | Impact |
|---|---|
| **CI-only analyzers** — Moved `EnforceCodeStyleInBuild`, `AnalysisLevel=latest-recommended`, `TreatWarningsAsErrors`, `GenerateDocumentationFile` behind `CI`/`TF_BUILD` condition | Biggest win — eliminates Roslyn style analysis overhead on every keystroke-triggered build |
| **Directory.Build.targets** — Explicitly disables `EnforceCodeStyleInBuild` locally | Required because .NET SDK 11+ defaults this on |
| **Removed redundant `ProjectReference`s** — WebApi had 3 refs (only needs BusinessLogic); Tests had 4 (only needs BusinessLogic); BusinessLogic had 2 (only needs DataAccess) | Reduces MSBuild graph evaluation and avoids duplicate assembly resolution |
| **Deduplicated `TargetFramework`** — Removed from each `.csproj` (already in `Directory.Build.props`) | Cleaner, single source of truth |
| **Trimmed solution platforms** — Removed unused x64/x86 configs (all projects build AnyCPU) | Fewer configurations for IDE/MSBuild to evaluate |
